description: This file implements a cache system for managing reply context in the BlueBubbles messaging application, including functions for storing, resolving, and pruning reply cache entries, as well as handling short ID mappings for message GUIDs.

methods.name: trimOrUndefined
methods.description: Trims a string or returns undefined if null, undefined, or empty after trimming.

methods.name: generateShortId
methods.description: Generates a new numeric short ID as a string.
